name: Work-item completion event intent mutation probe
command: npx vitest run packages/operator-core/lib/work-items-lifecycle.integration.test.ts -t "P-020 completion event intent" --reporter=dot
summary: The tool-call window is bounded by the P-020 mutation lock grant and completion. Against the current isolated PostgreSQL fixture, the guarded baseline passed all four completion-intent cases. Removing the completion intent token from the done-event payload failed three cases, including killed-producer recovery and both normal work-item families. The probe reported MUTANT CAUGHT and restored the source byte for byte.

assertions.evidence: Focused Vitest baseline: 4 passed, 46 filtered, exit 0.

Mutation changed only completionIntentIdOf(wi) to null inside emitWorkItemDoneEvent. Focused Vitest reported 3 failed assertions: the killed-producer reconciler emitted but could not acknowledge its intent, and normal feature and issue completion latches lacked the matching token.
mutation-probe.sh reported target=in-tree:lock-held, verdict=caught, baseline_exit=0, guard_exit=1, and tree integrity VERIFIED for work-items-events.ts.
